directTariff.scope: all Dream Energy stations in France

rule: From 2026-10-01, apply 0.59 EUR/kWh only to EVSE positively identified as direct Dream Energy stations in France. The 0.49 EUR/kWh promotion expired on 2026-09-30 and must not be extended. Do not use Dream Energy direct pricing for third-party RFID/eMSP or roaming rows. Preserve any separately proven occupancy/overstay fee.
sourceRefreshNote: Current direct tariff comes from the official Dream Energy FAQ. The tariffs page is retained to evidence the promotion end date.
